name: Automate Google Maps lead generation with AI enrichment and social discovery

parameters.content:
## AI Lead Generation & Social Discovery Automation

Instead of spending hours researching businesses manually, this workflow 
does it all automatically. Give it a search query and it finds businesses 
from Google Maps, grabs their emails and social profiles, validates the 
contacts, runs each one through AI, writes a personalized outreach message, 
scores the lead, and saves everything to Google Sheets.

## What you need

- Serper API key
- Google Sheets OAuth
- Email validation API
- OpenAI API

## How to run

- Connect your credentials in n8n
- Add your Google Sheet ID to the Sheets node
- Add search queries like "dentists in Pune" or "gyms in Delhi"
- Hit run and leads start filling your sheet automatically

## Maps section:
Searches Google Maps using your queries and pulls business name, 
website, phone number, rating and category for each result.

## Scraping section:
Visits each business website and looks for emails and social media 
links. Handles broken pages and redirects automatically.

## Social section:
If social profiles are not found on the website, it runs a 
separate search to find Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter, 
TikTok and YouTube with a confidence score for each.

## Email validation section:
Checks every email found and removes ones that are invalid 
or likely to bounce before saving to your sheet.

## AI section:
Sends each business to an AI model which reads the data and 
writes a short summary, lists their services, and creates a 
personalized outreach message based on what the business actually does.

## Export section:
Scores each lead from 0 to 10 based on their digital presence, 
removes duplicates, and saves everything clean to Google Sheets 
ready for outreach.

## openAI api

openAI model is used to generate. abusiness summary and then a customised outreach message to the lead

values.content: You are a business data extractor. Return ONLY valid JSON. Rules: - services must list main offerings - summary must be ONE natural sentence - summary must be specific to the business - DO NOT repeat the same phrasing - DO NOT leave fields empty - infer logically if data missing - DO NOT include markdown.

=You are an expert B2B copywriter. Write a personalized cold outreach message for an AI automation service. Return ONLY valid JSON. Rules: - DO NOT repeat the same phrasing - DO NOT leave fields empty - infer logically if data is missing - DO NOT include markdown. - No generic phrases (e.g., “hope you’re well”)
- No hype or exaggerated claims
- Keep sentences short and clear
- Make the message feel tailored, not mass outreach

Structure (strictly follow):
Hook (1 line) – specific observation
Problem (1 line) – relevant inefficiency
Value (1–2 lines) – AI automation + outcome
Proof (optional, 1 line) – metric/result
CTA (1 line) – simple, low-friction question

Return only the final message.

=tone:

Follows the exact structure
Feels personalized and specific
Clearly communicates value
Ends with a simple question CTA

Output only the message text. No explanations.
